description: This Java class defines a HealthRouteSupplier that provides an Akka HTTP Route which responds to health check requests. It interacts with an ActorRef to retrieve health status asynchronously and returns appropriate HTTP responses based on the health check outcome, including handling unexpected results and failures.

classes.name: HealthRouteSupplier
classes.description: Provides an Akka HTTP Route for health checks, querying a health-checking actor and generating JSON responses with status information.

methods.name: HealthRouteSupplier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the health-check actor reference and logging adapter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the Akka HTTP Route handling health check requests.

methods.name: handleHealthResult
methods.description: Processes the result of the health check; returns appropriate HTTP response based on success, failure, or unexpected result.

methods.name: completeHealthRequest
methods.description: Generates an HTTP response with health status in JSON format, or error status if health indicates DOWN.

methods.name: completeHealthRequest
methods.description: Generates an HTTP response indicating a failure occurred during health check.

methods.name: completeHealthRequestForUnexpectedHealthResult
methods.description: Handles unexpected health check result, logs error, and returns a service unavailable response.
